page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature mark at bottom left. Handwriting and show-through at the right edge are left out.

main_text.p: totus exercitus certatim conferret ope-rās, non interdiu, nm noctu laborem in-termittendo,tandem territi aggressi sunt diversa portus parte, qua peninsula procurrit in medium pelagus, fodiendo aperire os aliud, quo nullus agger procedere poterat propter maris altitudinem, & vim ventorum sævientem. Fodiebant autem populariter unà cum mulieribus & pueris, intus incipientes, & occulte versantes in opere: simulque triremes ac quinqueremes aedificabant è materia vetere, summa cum alacritate ac audacia. Et adeo celabant omnia, ut ne captivi quidem possent Scipioni quicquam manifestè dicere, nisi strepitum in portubus esse die noctuque continuum, caterum,in quem usum, se nescire: donec apparatu jam rebus omnibus Carthaginien-ses aperuerunt os portus circa diluculum, & eruperunt quinquaginta triremibus: cercuris vero, myoparonibus & aliis mi-noribus navigiis multis, ad terrorem or-natu egregie. Romanos & novum os repente apertum, & classu[?] inde erumpens terruit, ut Carthaginienses, si continuo classem aggressi fuissent, neglectam absentibus & ad oppugnationem versis tum sociis navalibus, tum remigibus, facile totam potuerint in suam potestatem redigere. Nunc quia fatale erat deleri Car-thagi-

page.notes: Long s is printed as a form resembling f and is transcribed as s. Doubtful readings: "nm" (line 2, probably non with a tilde), "caterum" (line 7, printed as "catecrum"), "se" (printed like "sc"), "classu" (printed as "classu", possibly "classe"). The digit "d" at the foot is taken as a gathering signature. Handwritten marks and show-through at the right edge are not transcribed. The text continues on the next page after "thagi-".
